book.name: Genesis
book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Yakoptatanamba Henga Ponda Aevulvna.
Doa nonamba honamba owousva mendekli phovna Kenan petharava.
Wo Yakoptatanamba nomba innemba hlapiana, temba seilmba ihilvonamba nomba Isipriniva, wo Yakopva henga hevna ombolm unna, ango henga Isipram, innepetam sovawolalm pivm.

Wo Yuta hovrini aralmba os omnana, yemba doara kava ishumnina, kuwulva nomba Isipriniva ovunna kamba mindnam. Os kamba ishunna, pevna boaslapevmoa hom waiambo, wo manam yimba pevhova ambvav. Yenamba moamba osva kava hillinvavmoa.
Wo yimba osva otava, boaslamba Bensaminmba wouta waiangota, osva kava si angavav, innemba sovawolalmba pivmba.
Wo yimba Bensaminmba ovotava, osva kava si angavavmoa, owai, manara nomba kuwulva Isipriniva doa kamba ishunna os, manam yimba hengava homba ambvav pevhova, pevna boaslapevmoa waiambo.
Wo Yakop ona, manara yimba eva ishumnivna nomba kuwulmba, kanamba mongova boaslalva luhunv? Yimba kamba kin plothumniv nonamba.

Wo ombolva una, nomba kuwulva kam sah owol vevna esvema mehonam katatanam. Hev ona, arapevpa mendah yenamba einvma a dahanami? Mongova yenamba boaslalva luhunvma a owaimi? Os sah owol vevna, wo noinda kava ishumnina hemba. Kava tit vina, ata kamba ishunvav, boaslapevmoa waiambo.

Wo Yuta henga aralm os ishomnana, yimba otava, wo osva kavna boaslamba Bensaminmba kava waiangavav. Wo os kava angavav mongawulm, innemba sovawolalmba. Wo osva si yemba kana tovotalmba, pimba si dalvavmoa owousrava, owai.
Ata kava beswonam waiangavav, wo kava waipromba owai vetava homba yeindamba, osva honamba kana kinmba si wohlohvav, verava, kamba si dahavav.
Wenokombo mindnam doa pimba vina, kava henga angav.

Doa aral ishunna, honamba osva phovmoa kana moarava, yeoa eva os viuta, manara ponda pimba aevulv. Wo boasna hui dumbu mana ema besal pivna petharini, wo os ianga Isipram, nom kuwulm nis dembreihu. Os yuhvpsu, tenen ten beswonam teihnung vevm, eva timov noi ten hlawol vevm,
eva dioa mindnam iango. Honaoa dioa henga iango, temba yena innewondarava Isipnindva nungunamba. Kava tit vev, dihi maivithina, wo noinda osva vina.
Wo eva boaslapevmoa Bensaminmoa waiango Isipna kuwulindam.

Wo Sesoa mendekli no Isipna kuwulna undmba weihaloh vremnara, wo himba si osva yemba wavra vovhoawol vinvav. Wo osva si Simeonmba phovav, temba buirava Isiprava livpa, wo eva Bensaminmba henga si homba provav beswonam. Wo mongova kanamba ombolva hoai vetava, kavkolo, si kamba wohdahavav. Doa angota.
Yosepna Etehumunilva Henga Isipram Angana, Bensaminm Waiangana.

Wo ombolva no denwit nunguwul vinamba, diva mindnam nunguwul vina, os angana, Bensaminmba waianganata. Anganamba, Isipra di kuwulm henga nonglapulvo. Mendah tit vrivna no kuwulmba Yosepmba hevna boaslalmba.

Wo Yosepva nongalna, ten hevna boaslalmba waiambvna, wo hev omnana andranindrinim, no hevnam deuvm kekalvho vremnavm, honaoa indhanamoa kana deuvram wongao, sapi mongo lurava os ningehu, honamba indhanamba ata kava wonnevav okomba hovranam.
Doa andranindriniva os vena, Yosep ten ishomnanam, etehumunilm wongamnana Yosepna deuvram.

Wo monam wongavna, etehumunilva pem vivna, hevm ishuna os, doara pina diva innewondamera hev dembhisuv vinna, wo himba honam nengnamba, wo pimba wonprov hona deuvramba. Ata pimba lelnam helvawol vivav, wo pimba ata andranindilm kekaiv vivav, eva pivna donkinahonam.
Wo tuvra doa saivvnamba, himba deuv kekalvhonindrinim di umnina os, yeoa kana moam hillinvm.
Nemetva kava hom Isipram ambna, innemba dina sovawolalmba, dina sovawol vinamba,

doa henga Kenandam os kavindam iangavna. Wo di monara shavna, wo diva kanamba innewondamera kava nungeilna. Indakonda nunguluhuku vinvna, diva kanamba mongova shelohnamoa. Daipotava diva nomba henga kava iambi yeindam. Kava tit viv, an dihi diva dembhisiha vena?
Wo mongova diva kava men doa iambi, innem sovawolalm henga.

Wo andranindrini unna, manam yimba duus vivav. Dihi Sesoa hev nengna, yemba beswonam vinna, no Sesoamba arapevpa yenamba sahlohmanav. No diva yenamba doara ka dombna, innem sovawolalm, manapenam. Doa andranindrini buiram gana, ganamba, Simeonmba wolaihapho, henga sis waipro, dom mongla etehumunil ten aevulvnam.
Yosepva Hevna Boaslakalelm Bensaminm Nonglana.
Wo no andranindriniva Yosepna etehumunilm wonsihana Yosepna deuvra, wo po vrahunna, monglam nonam poswolalm, eva etehumunilna donkim inne dahwol vinna.
Wo etehumunilva denwit meilna vivna, wondamerini dumbvna, ten iambnam Kenandini. Manara, doa hilli, mendekli kuwulva ata provav, ata hevm wonnevav okomba hovranam.
Wo Yosep prona, doa denwit noi dembreimnina, wo hev ku kusithapramna petharam, manara himba mendekli.
Wo Yosep moaivrowonam sah owol vevna, yimba beswonam aevulvma, eva arapevpa yenamba beswonam einvma, ten nemet pev kam ishumninam?
Wo etehumunilva una, kanamba aralva beswonam einv di Kenan pethara. Wo henga ku kusithapramna Yosepm.

Wo Yosep nonglana, Bensaminmba boaslakalelva men wailovahv etehumunil, wo unna, yena boaslapevpa hi, ten doara yepev kam ishumninam. Wo Bensaminm omnana, tuendisrini, Sesoa hev yemba wavra vovhoamnara, wo beswonam yimba huiva avav.
Wo Yosep und vevna hevna boaslalmba, wo lelnam wivelm vevna, wo noinda sandhalaha sihana hevna deuvmeram, di poaita wo vawovna.
Yosepva Hevna Etehumunilmba Henga Nembavrapa Vena Innerava.
Doa Yosepva wo vepianamba, wemba wuleihanamba, doa wenopva pora poswol venamba, henga os prona deuvmeriniva. Phonamba, hevna andranindm unna, inne kam hui meyasra dembhimnu.

Doa Yosepva hevna meyara avhoanamba hevho, wo murapeta di etehumunilva aevulthana mongona meyara hevho. Wo mongnahalva Isipnind aevulthangana, ten Yosepna deuvra shalvohvnam. Noinda osva vina, Isipnindva doara ovuvna, mongawulmba manam innemba wonhlavav Hiprunindmba.

Wo Yosepna moara andranindriniva etehumunilm hena meyara sandhana. Yosepna novlomossis sandhana os, miva etelm desvhoana, hovrava hovrinim sandhana, wo mullava Bensaminm boaslanonoam desvhoana. Wo etehumunilva hevm anongla venamba, pai, es hevpa honamba Isipna kuwulva pimba beswonamba levrapiawol vena, etel memba, hovrini memba, kalel memba, avamba pimba os tetwond vivna? Noinda osva una, mendah tit vivna, kuwulva Yosepva hevna boaslalmba.
Wo Yosep ona, wo andranind noi inne dumbe Yosepna meyarini, etehumunilmba lesowol vina hevna meyasra, wo Bensaminmba mindnam lisminina. Wo os innemba hlavna Yosepmongo, os ningvna lehra hevm.
